hits.title: Our RAG pipeline fell over in production at 40 QPS
hits.author: kmartens
hits.story_text: We ran a naive top-k retriever against pgvector and it held fine in staging. At 40 QPS the p99 went to nine seconds. Writing up what we changed.

hits.title: Ask HN: what does your RAG evaluation actually look like?
hits.author: dlin
hits.story_text: Every eval harness I have tried measures retrieval or generation but never the pair. Curious what people run before a production deploy.
